status: Locked before E18/E19 outcomes; no parameter selection using new outcomes
scope: E18 saved-score realized-loss diagnosis; E19 controlled simulation; author-executed clean-environment reproduction.
preservation: Existing E0-E17 results, figure 1, author metadata and submission files are not edited.

bootstrap.scheme: Existing noncircular contiguous date blocks, concatenate/truncate to 60 dates; same weights for all terms

E18.weekly: Relative evaluation weeks, all four origins; final partial week marked
E18.outcome_contributions: Group sums divided by total cohort N; additive, not conditional group means
E18.logloss: Retain paired score results; no Brier decomposition asserted for log loss
E18.interpretation: Post-hoc realized-loss diagnostic; aggregate A is not an individual alignment guarantee or a causal attribution

E19.seed_rule: SeedSequence([20261020, scenario_index, replicate_index]); scenario=0..3, replicate=0..99; technical tests use replicate>=10000

scenarios.name: Shape
scenarios.c: Gauss-Hermite 100-node integration and Brent root: each phase has E(pi)=E(expit(z)); no labels used

E19.outcomes: Independent Bernoulli(pi) conditional on each order's generated score and phase
E19.event_assumption: All simulated orders eventually complete; continuous perfect status observation and zero ingestion lag

information_policies.Immediate: r=a (unavailable in practice); only prior-day labels used at daily updates
information_policies.Observed: r=min(v,d), late status knowable at deadline

E19.policy_pairing: Same scores, approvals, deadlines, completion times and labels within a scenario/replicate
E19.pool: Approval and information-policy eligibility strictly before daily midnight; Rolling60 additionally eligibility>=day-60
E19.frozen: Fit once at day 60 using policy-specific eligible pool, then retain unchanged
E19.calibration: Unpenalized log-loss intercept; same support thresholds as E17; PoolRate uses the Expanding pool
E19.solver: Newton with analytic derivative, max 30 iterations, mean residual <=1e-12; Brent fallback; log all failures/fallbacks
E19.statistics: Per-sequence paired differences; mean, sample SD, MCSE, t(99) 95% confidence interval; independent sequence is replication unit
E19.multiplicity: Marginal descriptive intervals; no unadjusted familywise significance or equivalence claim
checks: y agrees with completion vs deadline
earlier on-time observation leaves closed pool and forecasts invariant
Frozen and Expanding coincide at first evaluation update
E19.no_external_validation: Synthetic results test constructed mechanisms and do not identify the cause of Olist changes

reproduction.public: Fresh extracted public archive and newly created venv installed from pinned requirements
reproduction.run_by: Same research assistant, not independent third party
reproduction.third_party_status: Not performed; requires a person uninvolved in implementation
reproduction.external_data: No new dataset; module D conditional and not executed

resources.gpu: Not used; exact CPU intercept models and frozen LR preserved
resources.memory: 32 GiB installed; monitor actual resource use; do not oversubscribe thread libraries

stop: Run all prespecified cases regardless of sign. Corrections only for documented technical errors; no favorable parameter search.
